title: The Daily Compass｜每日罗盘
subtitle: A bilingual daily briefing for navigating global news, culture, AI, and social change.
theme: 证据、照护与数据再利用：美伊谈判、住房资金、拘留抗议、盆腔疼痛、Hockney与军事AI
introChinese: 今天的小报关键词是：evidence, care, and data reuse（证据、照护与数据再利用）。战争目标需要法律证据，医疗痛苦需要被制度认真识别，而数字时代最隐蔽的问题之一是：我们为了游戏、便利或办案留下的数据，最终会被谁用于什么目的。

items.title: 美伊和平协议仍未落定，美国打击目标引发法律质疑
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，特朗普声称美伊协议接近达成，但德黑兰否认协议在即；法律专家同时质疑部分美国打击目标是否可能构成战争罪。外交乐观与法律争议并存，说明结束战争不仅需要政治宣言，也需要查明行动责任。
items.correspondingEnglish: A US-Iran peace agreement remained elusive. President Trump said a deal was close, while Tehran denied that an agreement was imminent. Legal experts also questioned whether some US targets could amount to war crimes. Ending a war requires more than political optimism; it also requires legal scrutiny of how force was used.

englishExpressions.example: A final peace deal remained elusive.
Military targets require legal scrutiny.
Iran denied that an agreement was imminent.

items.title: 特朗普政府削减洛杉矶无家可归者服务机构联邦资金
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，美国住房与城市发展部以涉嫌欺诈为由削减洛杉矶无家可归者服务机构的联邦资金，这是联邦政府与加州最新冲突。反欺诈审查有其必要性，但突然撤资也可能首先影响最依赖住房、外展和心理健康服务的人。
items.correspondingEnglish: Trump administration officials cut federal funding to a Los Angeles homelessness-services agency, alleging fraud. The decision became another clash between the federal government and California. Fraud investigations may be necessary, but abrupt funding cuts can first affect people who depend on housing, outreach and mental-health services.

englishExpressions.example: The agency lost federal funding.
Homelessness services include housing and outreach.
Abrupt funding cuts can interrupt essential care.

items.title: 近40名女性加入ICE拘留中心绝食抗议
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，近40名被关押在新泽西 Delaney Hall 的女性加入男性拘留者发起的绝食，并提出以基本人权为基础的诉求。绝食让被隔离的身体成为公共证词，也显示拘留条件、医疗照护和法律程序必须接受外部监督。
items.correspondingEnglish: Nearly 40 women detained at Delaney Hall joined men in a hunger strike and outlined demands rooted in basic human rights. Hunger strikes turn isolated bodies into public testimony. Detention conditions, medical care and legal procedures require independent oversight.

englishExpressions.example: The detained women joined a hunger strike.
The protest focused on detention conditions.
Detention facilities require independent oversight.

items.title: 盆腔疼痛的昂贵代价：延迟诊断与保险缺口
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，患有外阴阴道疼痛的患者常因诊断延迟和保险缺口花费数千美元。疼痛被长期忽视后，患者容易进入反复检查、自费治疗与不确定建议的循环。医疗成本不仅来自疾病，也来自系统不相信或不能识别某些身体经验。
items.correspondingEnglish: Patients with vulvovaginal and pelvic pain can spend thousands of dollars because of delayed diagnosis and insurance gaps. When pain is not recognized early, people may enter a cycle of repeated tests, private treatment and uncertain advice. Medical costs are produced not only by illness, but also by systems that fail to recognize bodily experience.

englishExpressions.example: Pelvic pain can be difficult to diagnose.
Delayed diagnosis increases financial and emotional costs.
Insurance gaps leave patients paying privately.

sections.heading: 艺术、时尚与媒体 / Art, Fashion & Media

items.title: 英国艺术家David Hockney去世，享年88岁
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，以泳池、肖像和加州阳光闻名的英国艺术家 David Hockney 去世。他从未停止跨越绘画、摄影、舞台与数字工具，成为当代艺术最重要的创新者之一。其作品提醒我们，风格不是固定标签，也可以是一种持续更新观看方式的能力。
items.correspondingEnglish: David Hockney, the pioneering British artist known for pools, portraits and sunlit California scenes, died aged 88. He continued moving across painting, photography, stage design and digital tools. His career shows that style can be less a fixed label than an ability to keep renewing how the world is seen.

englishExpressions.example: Hockney was a pioneering British artist.
He continued to break artistic barriers.
The artist embraced digital tools late in his career.

items.title: Lyse Doucet以阿富汗“人民史”获得女性非虚构写作奖
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，BBC首席国际记者 Lyse Doucet 凭《The Finest Hotel in Kabul》获得女性非虚构写作奖。她希望这部以普通人经验构成的阿富汗历史，让外界继续关注塔利班对女性的严厉压迫。人民史让宏大政治重新获得面孔、声音与日常细节。
items.correspondingEnglish: BBC chief international correspondent Lyse Doucet won the Women’s prize for nonfiction for The Finest Hotel in Kabul. She hopes the book’s people-centered history will draw attention to the Taliban’s harsh treatment of women. A people’s history gives faces, voices and daily detail back to geopolitical events.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 人民史；以普通人经验为中心的历史
englishExpressions.example: The book presents a people’s history of Afghanistan.
The author hopes to draw attention to Afghan women.
The book won a major nonfiction prize.

sections.heading: 人工智能与科技 / AI & Tech

items.title: 英国警员因涉嫌使用AI生成“证据材料”接受刑事调查
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，德比郡一名警员因涉嫌使用AI生成证据材料被调离一线并接受调查，这是英国首例已知同类案件。生成式AI进入执法后，错误不再只是内容瑕疵，而可能影响自由与定罪，因此必须保存来源、操作记录和人工核验链条。
items.correspondingEnglish: A Derbyshire police officer was removed from frontline duties and placed under criminal investigation over allegedly AI-generated evidential material. It is believed to be the first known case of its kind in the UK. In policing, synthetic content can affect liberty and prosecution, making provenance, audit logs and human verification essential.

englishExpressions.example: The investigation concerns allegedly generated evidential material.
AI-assisted evidence needs a complete audit trail.
Sensitive decisions require human verification.

items.title: Pokémon Go位置扫描数据被用于训练军事无人机视觉AI
items.summaryChinese: The Guardian 报道，Pokémon Go玩家提供的位置扫描帮助训练识别和理解物理空间的AI，而相关能力可能用于战区军事无人机。娱乐数据的二次用途说明，同意使用一款游戏并不等于真正理解数据未来会进入哪些系统。
items.correspondingEnglish: Location scans collected through Pokémon Go helped train AI to recognize and interpret physical spaces, technology that could assist military drones in war zones. The secondary use of entertainment data shows that agreeing to play a game is not the same as understanding every future system that may use the resulting data.

englishExpressions.example: Users may not anticipate secondary data use.
The game collected location scans from physical spaces.
Civilian data can acquire a military application.

englishParagraph.english: Today’s stories ask what counts as evidence and who receives care. Military action needs legal scrutiny, while public services can disappear before allegations are fully tested. Hunger strikes and chronic pain turn bodily experience into evidence of institutional failure. Art and nonfiction preserve other forms of testimony. In policing and location-based games, data can travel far beyond its original purpose. Responsible systems must therefore explain where information came from, how it was transformed and who may be harmed by its reuse.
englishParagraph.chinese: 今天的新闻追问什么能够被视为证据，以及谁能够获得照护。军事行动需要法律审查，公共服务却可能在指控得到充分核实前消失；绝食和慢性疼痛让身体经验成为制度失灵的证据；艺术与非虚构写作保存其他形式的证词。在执法和位置游戏中，数据可能远离最初用途。负责任的系统必须说明信息来自哪里、如何被转化，以及二次利用可能伤害谁。

keywords.example: Delayed diagnosis can increase the cost of care.

keywords.meaning: 证词；对亲历事件的讲述
keywords.example: Books and protests can preserve testimony.
Secondary data use should be explained to users.

sentenceLab.sentence: Agreeing to play a game is not the same as understanding every future system that may use the resulting data.
sentenceLab.analysisChinese: A is not the same as B 用于区分两种常被混同的行为。that may use the resulting data 是定语从句，修饰 every future system。

reflection.english: Evidence becomes trustworthy when its origin, transformation and consequences remain visible.
reflection.chinese: 今天最想留下的一句话是：只有当来源、转化过程与后果保持可见，证据才可能获得信任。
